meta_description:
9,252 likes, 15 comments - friendsnational on October 6, 2026: "Dream big. And then dream bigger. 💛 

That was the message @simonebiles shared when she spent an afternoon with our youth and Friends in the Twin Cities. 

Simone talked about much more than gymnastics. She shared the importance of asking for help, having trusted adults in your life, persevering when things are hard, and believing that your dreams are possible. 

As a former foster youth herself, Simone also shared why Friends of the Children has meant so much to her: 

“I wish I had something like that, kind of that constant, that you guys have with your mentors.” 

Our kids asked questions, shared their own dreams, ate pizza, laughed, and got to spend time with someone who reminded them that even the biggest accomplishments start with a dream and people who believe in you. 

THANK YOU, Simone, for continuing to be in the corner of Friends youth everywhere. 

#DreamBigger #GOAT #FriendsOfTheChildren #FriendsTwinCities #MentorsMatter #SimoneBiles".
